risks: 多名董事在闭门期前申报有意交易公司股份。

events.what_en: Signing of plantation rights disposal agreement

recent_en: MBL's indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Sokor Gemilang Ladang signed a sale and purchase agreement with Maluri Avenue One on 29 September 2026 to dispose of its plantation rights for RM16 million, followed by supplementary and amended announcements. Board members declared their intention to deal during the closed period.
notable_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Sokor Gemilang Ladang disposed of plantation rights to Maluri Avenue One for RM16 million.
The company issued supplementary information and an amended announcement on the disposal.
risks_en: Several directors declared intention to deal in the company's shares ahead of the closed period.
